name: Process Spawn Policy
description: Define which processes can spawn child processes, with which arguments, in which directories. Unauthorized spawn attempts are blocked with receipts. Child processes inherit minimal capabilities.
purpose: Prevent unauthorized process creation by enforcing a spawn policy that controls which processes can create children, with what arguments, in what working directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Process spawn policy defines which processes may spawn children
Allowed binary paths, argument patterns, and working directories are enumerated
Blocked spawns produce security event receipts
Child processes inherit minimal capabilities (no ambient authority)
Spawn policy is verified against the OS process tree
